summary: @ornikar/rollup-plugin-postcss preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: This package is a scoped copy of the well-known rollup-plugin-postcss plugin, but adds a preinstall lifecycle hook `node setup.mjs` that upstream does not have. On `npm install`, setup.mjs checks whether the Bun runtime is present on the host and, if not, downloads a Bun release zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it, and then invokes the downloaded Bun binary via execFileSync to run a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a single-line ~727KB Bun-tagged bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array obfuscation with a rotating shuffle function (`WV8StW` performing repeated `push(shift())`), making its runtime behavior opaque to Node-based inspection. A Rollup PostCSS plugin has no legitimate need for the Bun runtime or a 700KB obfuscated Bun-only module, and the alternate-runtime path bypasses Node lifecycle observers and require-graph inspection. Installation of this package executes attacker-supplied obfuscated code on the installer's machine automatically.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
